name: AliceAI-Foundation-80B-A3B-Base

lineage.how_derived: trained entirely from scratch on a newly assembled corpus; key choices validated in separate 2T-token from-scratch runs

purpose: Base model with a hybrid MoE architecture, strong in Russian factual knowledge and on par with larger open models on math, programming and reasoning (card, translated from Russian); published with the WikiWebFacts and HardMultiQA benchmarks.

license.name: Apache-2.0
license.notes: LICENSE read: short Apache-2.0 notice with 'Copyright 2026 YANDEX LLC' and the standard grant text referencing the full licence.

pc-12gb.notes: 48.42 GB file against 9.6 GB VRAM plus 50 GB RAM budget; experts stream from RAM (~3 B active, decode bound by RAM bandwidth)

pc-16gb.notes: 48.42 GB file against 13.6 GB VRAM plus 50 GB RAM budget; experts stream from RAM (~3 B active, decode bound by RAM bandwidth)

pc-24gb.notes: 48.42 GB file against 21.6 GB VRAM plus 82 GB RAM budget; experts stream from RAM (~3 B active, decode bound by RAM bandwidth)

pc-32gb.notes: 48.42 GB file against 29.6 GB VRAM plus 82 GB RAM budget; experts stream from RAM (~3 B active, decode bound by RAM bandwidth)

mac-16-24gb.notes: 48.42 GB file against a GPU share of about 12 GB (KV cache not included)

mac-32gb.notes: 48.42 GB file against a GPU share of about 22 GB (KV cache not included)

mac-64gb+.notes: 48.42 GB file against a GPU share of about 52 GB (KV cache not included)

engine_support.notes: Community GGUFs exist; llama.cpp support not verified.

tona_fit.reason: For Russian-language users a 3B-active model that fits 64 GB machines is interesting, but it is a base model; wait for an instruct release.
